history.value: The two 399-game SharpHide bursts (adaptation-curve, patched sharp2, sharp2-hp0.9, ritual2) @hpb0.01@tsl1 on gen batch 1, elites, 1000 starts (675 elite) x 4 seeds, paired with the bench's first 4 seeds: cost (net - heuristic)(mechanic) - (same)(control), HP lost per elite fight, zero-shot / seed 1 / seed 2: AttackLoss-Damage x Nob +13.29 (0.90) / +1.91 (0.40) / +2.02 (0.46) (wins 0.698 / 0.933 / 0.928, heuristic 0.944); OppCard-PlainDamage x Sentries +5.39 (0.63) / +0.31 / +0.74 (wins 0.636 / 0.803 / 0.800); AttackLoss-Strength all elites +0.74 / -2.06 / -1.08. So a burst on one power that punishes attacking repairs the pack's version and the one that punishes any card played (transfer across triggers inside the family). Interference: OppCard-Vulnerable, the zero-shot net's largest edge (-9.53 (0.58)), goes to +0.36 / -1.72, net wins 0.841 -> 0.670 / 0.707 (heuristic 0.682; Sentries 0.765 -> 0.417 / 0.522), while the official parents' wins held (0.987); seed 2 also loses 4.4 HP on the Lagavulin parent and 2-3 HP on the turn-trigger damage mechanics. Two seeds of one recipe.
